settings.heading: Deals for bulk orders
settings.intro: Fitting out an office, hotel, café or a client’s home? We print fine art on cotton canvas, stretched over wooden frames, in the sizes your walls need.
settings.minimum_note: Bulk orders usually start from around EGP 15,000.
settings.whatsapp_message: Hi Art Cellar, I'd like to ask about a bulk order.
settings.faq_minimum: Bulk orders usually start from around EGP 15,000. If your project is a little smaller, send it anyway and we’ll see what we can do.
settings.faq_time: Usually [X–Y] working days, depending on the number of pieces. We’ll confirm the date with your quote.
